newsitem.title: UK: DATED BRENT TRADES AT SEPT BRENT -20 CTS.
newsitem.headline: DATED BRENT TRADES AT SEPT BRENT -20 CTS.

text.p: A Dated Brent cargo traded at Sept Brent -20 cents on Tuesday, traders said.
The August 20-22 loader moved between two traders a few hours after a Wall Street trader sold a U.S. major an August 23-25 cargo for Sept -15 cents, they added.
The second deal brought the level of Dated Brent back towards the level that has held since last Thursday when the same August 20-22 cargo fetched Sept Brent -20 cents.
